name: Tally
description: Create Tally forms faster with AI. Describe what you need in plain English, and the app generates clear, well-structured questions you can use right away. Perfect for surveys, feedback forms, applications, and registrations, it helps you go from idea to ready-to-build form in seconds while keeping your workflow simple and efficient.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Tally to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Tally to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.tally.so/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Tally MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tally lists 26 MCP tools, including apply_logic, configure_blocks, create_blocks, create_new_form, extract_brand, fetch_insights, fetch_submissions, inspect_custom_css, list_blocks, list_forms, list_workspaces, and load_form.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Tally?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Tally in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Tally requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Tally is developed by Tally Forms. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
